audit_scope: High-leverage trading assumptions and market microstructure considerations

entry_offset_logic.problem: System enters EXACTLY at S/R level with 20% scoring bonus

key_facts: Price regularly wicks THROUGH S/R levels before bouncing (liquidation hunting)
Market makers actively hunt stop clusters at obvious levels
40x leverage: 2.5% move = liquidation, wicks can be 0.5-1% easily
Professional entry offset: +0.3 to +0.5× ATR INSIDE zone (toward current price)
Entry AT level = high risk of liquidation before bounce

entry_offset_logic.impact: High risk of liquidation on wick-through before S/R bounce occurs

fix_implemented.optimal_preference: ✅ 0.2-0.5×ATR inside zone gets 1.1x bonus, distance=0 gets no bonus

entry_scoring_bias.problem: Scoring explicitly rewards entering AT S/R level (distance=0.0 → 1.2x multiplier)
entry_scoring_bias.why_wrong: Ignores BTC perp market structure: stop hunts, liquidation wicks, market maker behavior
entry_scoring_bias.fix: Optimal entry should be 0.3-0.5×ATR INSIDE zone, not AT level

position_sizing_liquidation_risk.problem: Position sizing uses R:R multiplier but doesn't consider DISTANCE to liquidation
position_sizing_liquidation_risk.scenario: High R:R trade → larger position → closer to liquidation → wick can trigger liq before SL
position_sizing_liquidation_risk.example: Entry $90,000, SL $89,700 (0.33%), Liq $88,900 (1.2%). Large position → 0.7% wick hits liquidation, SL never triggers
position_sizing_liquidation_risk.fix_required: Add liquidation_distance_factor to position sizing: reduce size if liq is close to SL

sr_liquidation_wick_filtering.problem: S/R detection finds levels with wicks but doesn't distinguish natural wicks from liquidation/stop-hunt wicks
sr_liquidation_wick_filtering.research_findings: Levels with high wick rejection often indicate stop hunting zones → higher risk
sr_liquidation_wick_filtering.impact: System may trade levels that are actively hunted by market makers
sr_liquidation_wick_filtering.fix_required: Add 'wick_rejection_ratio' and 'stop_hunt_risk' scoring to S/R levels

spread_cost_omission.problem: Spread checked for scalping strategy viability, but NOT factored into entry/exit profit calculations
spread_cost_omission.impact: Predicted profit doesn't account for spread costs → overestimation
spread_cost_omission.fix_required: Subtract spread cost from TP distance when calculating R:R ratio

round_number_stop_clustering.problem: No avoidance of stop placement at round numbers ($90,000, $95,000, $100,000, etc)

research_findings.key_fact: Stops cluster heavily at round numbers → stop hunt targets → liquidation risk

round_number_stop_clustering.fix_required: Offset stops by small random/deterministic amount (e.g., $89,950 instead of $90,000)

liquidation_calculation.implementation: Uses actual observed rate 1.226% for 40x (not theoretical 2.5%)

stop_loss_liquidation_protection.implementation: Caps SL at liquidation ± 0.5% buffer, ensures SL triggers BEFORE liquidation
stop_loss_liquidation_protection.note: However, doesn't avoid obvious levels (round numbers)

atr_calculation.validation: Research confirms this is standard for BTC perp trading (adapts to volatility)

research_sources: Academic: 'Support and Resistance Levels towards Profitability in Algorithmic Trading' (MDPI 2025)
Academic: 'Evidence and Behaviour of S/R Levels in Financial Time Series' (2021)
Professional: BTC perp entry offset best practices (0.3-0.5×ATR standard)
Behavioral: Round number clustering in BTC trading (Investopedia, CryptoChartInsights 2025)
recommended_priority: 1. Fix entry offset logic (CRITICAL - affects every trade)
2. Fix entry scoring bias (CRITICAL - actively prefers wrong entries)
3. Add position sizing liquidation risk factor (MAJOR - prevents blow-ups)
4. Add S/R liquidation wick filtering (MAJOR - avoids stop hunt zones)
5. Add spread cost to profit calculations (MAJOR - realistic P&L)
6. Add round number stop avoidance (MAJOR - reduces stop hunt risk)
